scripts.api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn main:app --app-dir apps/api --port 8000
scripts.check:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api pyright -p apps/api && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api python -m evidencedesk.cli migrate
scripts.db:seed: uv run --project apps/api python -m evidencedesk.cli seed
scripts.eval:offline: uv run --project apps/api python -m evidencedesk.evaluation --mode offline --split all --limit 40
scripts.eval:smoke: uv run --project apps/api python -m evidencedesk.evaluation --mode live --split development --limit 10
scripts.db:cleanup: uv run --project apps/api python -m evidencedesk.cli cleanup
scripts.db:ingest-live: uv run --project apps/api python -m evidencedesk.cli ingest-live
